title: Pumpkin Painting
description:
Join us for a fun and creative evening of pumpkin decorating and floral decoupage. Create your own unique fall inspired masterpiece to take home while enjoying a relaxing and social atmosphere.
$40 pp,  all materials provided

title: Introduction to Mahjong
description: Join Toby Myers & Cindy Synder for an intro to Mahjong.  This workshop is a two evening class in order to gain the knowledge to play in your own group.  All materials provided including the 2026 Mahjong Card.  $100 pp for two classes. 10/7 & 10/14 Class is limited to 12 people (3 tables of 4)

title: Backyard Comedy Night
description: Join us for some laughs in the backyard with local standups. Beer and wine for sale 😊

title: Cafecito Mio’s Paint & Sip
description: Cafecito Mio’s Autumn Paint & Sip is a cozy morning of greca painting, autumn charm bracelet making, seasonal cafecitos, artisanal sodas, and fall bites. Guests can expect a relaxed, café-style creative experience with all supplies included.

title: Make Your Own Perfume
description: Back by Popular Demand, This intro to perfumery will cover everything you need to know to start making your own blends! We will cover the basics of making perfume, evaluate several raw materials and construct accords that we will blend into our scents. $60 per person

title: Sourdough Starter Workshop
description: Create your own sourdough starter while learning the basics of sourdough baking in this beginner-friendly, hands-on workshop. You’ll build a sourdough starter from scratch, explore the basics of fermentation, and create your own sourdough loaf to bake at home. $40

title: Paint & Sip Pottery Night
description: This one's for the people who keep saying "I should try that" and never do. Grab a brush, pick your colors, and make something with your hands, no experience needed, no talent required. Paint your pot! One glass of wine included.

title: Pet Portrait Watercolor Class
description:
Create a hand painted portrait of your pet! 

WHAT’S INCLUDED
All materials needed for the class are included:
• Hand-sketched outline of your pet• High-quality watercolor board• Curated paint palette and Brushes
• Watercolor guide and 1 on 1 instruction

$85pp

title: Live on Lang  - The Greenjay
description: Join The Greenjays in the backyard!  Live music under twinkling lights. Beer and wine available for purchase. $16 per person

title: Mama & Mini Pilates
description: Join us on October 17th at 10 AM at The House on Lang for a cozy, welcoming morning of mommy & me Pilates designed with mamas in mind. Whether you’re postpartum, pregnant, or simply looking for a fun way to move with your little one, you’re welcome here. $10

title: Bake Club
description: Fall is right around the corner, so let's get a taste of it! Bring your favorite Fall flavors, it can be savory or sweet!  Every attendee must bring something! No store bought baked good, please!

title: Mahjong Game Night-Guided Play
description: Already know Mahjong, come play to level up or play with friends during guided play.  Game sets provided. Bring your Mahjong card. $25 pp.  Drink specials available for purchase.

title: Silk Scarf Custom Dying
description: Back by popular demand, learn the delicate art of naturally dying and designing your own silk scarf.  Class includes all materials and instruction by Shalini, a well known silk artist. $$60pp. makes a great gift!

title: Create Your First Junk Journal
description: Create your very own junk journal! ✂️📖 Your ticket includes a handmade journal and all the supplies you’ll need to decorate and personalize it. Bring your own “junk” from trips or special moments—ticket stubs, receipts, photos, postcards, and little keepsakes to make your journal uniquely yours! 💌

title: Full Moon Yoga in Backyard
description: We will Celebrate the full moon on October 22nd. Bring water, mat and towel. Arrive early and shop! Always a special for Yogis on Full Moon night! Any Purchase in the Shop, and Maddie will discount next month's Yoga!   $15pp For more info Follow @maddieplocklear

title: Make your Own Holiday Ornaments
description: Join Casey from Sunshine ln Pottery and hand make your personalize glazed pottery Ornaments. You will learn the basics of pottery textures and glazes. Once you have created your one of kind ornaments, they will be double glazed and returned to the shop for pick up at your convenience.  $60pp

title: Spooky Season Reflection
description: Join us at House on Lang for an afternoon of PJs, prompts, and pumpkin-spiced vibes! Unwind, reset, and celebrate autumn with a low-pressure creative session designed to help you set your fall intentions.
